description:
Elections Commission - List of Assistant Returning Officers for the Presidential Election - 2019
(Received on 2019.10.23)
reasoning: This gazette notice is an official announcement by the Election Commission regarding the appointment of Assistant Returning Officers for the Colombo Electoral District in connection with the Presidential Election to be held on November 16th, 2019. It falls under the Elections category as it specifically deals with electoral processes, officer appointments for election duties, and is issued under the Presidential Elections Act.
